echo "=== versions ==="; node -v; npm -v; PATH=$PATH:/usr/share/dotnet dotnet --version; docker --version
echo "=== keycloak client roles ==="; docker exec strassennamen-keycloak /opt/keycloak/bin/kcadm.sh get clients -r my-realm --fields id,clientId 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print([c['id'] for c in d if c['clientId']=='strassennamen'][0])" > /tmp/cid.txt; CID=$(cat /tmp/cid.txt); docker exec strassennamen-keycloak /opt/keycloak/bin/kcadm.sh get clients/$CID/roles -r my-realm 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json;print([r['name'] for r in json.load(sys.stdin)])"
echo "=== realm roles ==="; docker exec strassennamen-keycloak /opt/keycloak/bin/kcadm.sh get roles -r my-realm 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json;print([r['name'] for r in json.load(sys.stdin)])"
echo "=== frontend main.js served ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "main.js HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:4200/main.js
